items.title: Gingerbread Pair Holding a Blank Banner Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white gingerbread pair holding a blank ribbon banner, one in a bow tie and the other in a bonnet and scalloped dress.
items.description: Different face shapes and body proportions frame the open writing space across the center.

items.title: Five Gingerbread Cookies on a Teal Tray
items.alt: Teal baking tray holding five different smiling gingerbread cookies shaped as a heart, star, tree, bell and house.
items.description: The cookies stand in a loose row over a cream liner, with the tray's two full handles visible.
